name: @dcms/site-template-react
description: The starter templates for DCMS Mode B sites and the Mode D (visual) site scaffold, embedded into admin-api. Its build typechecks every template against shared/src/api, a committed copy of real generated client output, and the visual template against the staged @dcms/site-runtime source.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.blank.json && tsc -p tsconfig.content.json && tsc -p tsconfig.landing.json && node scripts/stage-visual-runtime.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.visual.json
